standard: MCC Laws of Cricket, 2017 Code 4th Edition (2026), Law 4.1, adult men / Size 1: circumference 224–229 mm; midpoint 226.5 mm, diameter 72.097 mm.
construction: Glossy red leather shell with a subtle recessed equatorial join aligned to a raised central primary welt. Six rows of cream stitches are actual geometry, 72 stitches in each row (432 strands). Two shallow quarter-cover seams are thin geometry. Grain is a baked normal map.
approximation: The outer shell is a continuous editable sphere; four cover regions are visually delineated by the primary and quarter seams, not separately cut leather solids. The six stitch rows use an illustrative 72 stitches per row, not a count specified by MCC. Five-sided thread and sampled seam tubes reduce geometry; no core or physical seam mechanics.
